LoadingArt.png|{{Color|Premium|Classic}} [[Railgun Tank]] on the loading screen art. }} ==Skin Trivia== *The units of the second version of the Default '''Military Base''' were all made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/5574963/profile GregTame]. *Despite the [[Railgun Tank]] having a humanoid riding the vehicle, it had no face meaning the [[Military Base]] had no [[April Fools 2020|Funny Faces]]. *The upgrade icon for the Level 3 [[Military Base]] does not show the barbed wire on the bullbar, unlike the original '''Humvee 3''' model. *The original version of the [[Humvee 3]] and a khaki version of the second version of the [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] appeared in the second and third versions of [[Forest Camp]]. *The original variant of '''Tank''' appeared to be based on a typical tank chassis, similar to that of the [[wp:Leopard 2|Leopard 2]]. **The current version of the '''Tank''' appears to be based on the [[wp:T-90|T-90 Russian Tank]]. **The second and third version of the '''Tank''' appeared to have a similar chassis to the [[wp:Crusader tank|British Crusader tank]]. ***They may have been inspired by the [[w:c:resistance:M-12 Sabertooth|M-12 Sabertooth Tank]] from ''Resistance: Fall of Man''. *The {{Color|Premium|Classic}} skin for the '''Military Base''' uses the same humanoid found in the [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Mecha Base]]. *Despite the {{Color|Premium|Classic}} skin being based on the first version of the Default skin, it does not include the [[Motorcycle]]. *Weirdly, the Level 0-2 {{Color|Premium|Classic}} skin has the [[Humvee 3|Truck 3]] parked near it, despite not spawning that unit until Level 3. *The Apocalyptic [[Railgun Tank]] was actually to the game as a unit in the [[Overhaul v1.3|Frost Invasion Update]]. **It was referred to as Tank3 and, despite being a skin for the [[Railgun Tank]], it had the [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] statistics. **Although the unit would be unused, the Apocalyptic [[Railgun Tank]] model can be found in [[Wrecked Battlefield II]]. *The {{Color|Deluxe|Cyber}} vehicle is based on the real life [[wp:Tesla Cybertruck|Tesla Cybertruck]]. **Its release had caused controversy among the community, due to actions of Elon Musk shortly before the release of the skin. https://archive.ph/KbakL. Archived from [https://x.com/BelowNatural/status/1882208516733374963/photo/1 the original] *The number in the name of the {{Color|Patriotic|Base 1776}} skin, "''1776''", is a reference to the year in which the United States of America adopted its Declaration of Independence. *The {{Color|Pirate}} skin actually had a custom plane made for it, which can even be seen in the background of the thumbnail for [[v2.3.0]], specifically the one with the [[Pirate Crate]] skins, though it was not added to the game. ==Update History== ''This only refers to cosmetic changes to the [[Military Base]].
